lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Reward: Toolbox ×2

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That was great!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Thanks for hanging out with me today.
No, thank you.
It was an amazing experience.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The two Raptures you saw today,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Crawler and Squid,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: they're quite the dynamic duo.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Both are imitating sea creatures that we don't see anymore.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Maybe not exactly the same, but a close enough imitation.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Isn't it amazing?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The fact that these Raptures are imitating animals that are extinct

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: since their arrival.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Perhaps people, thousands of years from now,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: can surmise what sort of animals have wandered the surface

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: by looking at these guys!
Gives me the willies just by thinking about it.
It's ironic when you think about it.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I can see why you'd feel that way.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You must feel like the Raptures have driven

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: all the old wildlife we were so familiar with to extinction.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I can see why you'd feel that way.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: In a way, the Raptures have taken the place of the animals from the past.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Nature has always evolved that way,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: and the arrival of Raptures may simply be a part of it!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Anyway, how do you feel about

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: observing higher class Raptures

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: next time?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It goes without saying that it'll be much more dangerous.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: However, it's a completely different experience,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: as they imitate more highly evolved creatures

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: than the ones you saw today.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: If anything comes up, I'll let you know!
